The emerald is the birthstone for May.
祖母綠是五月的誕生石。
The lake had emerald green water.
那座湖有翠綠色的湖水。
She wore an emerald dress to the party.
她穿著翠綠色的洋裝去參加派對。
He was falsely accused of stealing the money.
他被誤指偷了那筆錢。
The advertisement falsely claimed that the product was safe.
那則廣告不實地宣稱產品是安全的。
She falsely believed that the exam was cancelled.
她誤以為考試取消了。
The news of his death saddened everyone in the village.
他過世的消息讓村裡每個人都很難過。
It saddens me to see the old park in such a bad state.
看到老公園破敗的樣子，我很難過。
The sad ending of the movie saddened the audience.
電影悲傷的結局讓觀眾感到難過。
The government mobilised thousands of volunteers to help after the flood.
政府在水災後動員了數千名志工來幫忙。
The mayor tried to mobilise support for the new library.
市長試著為新圖書館動員支持。
We need to mobilise all our resources to finish on time.
我們得調動所有資源才能準時完成。
An arched doorway led into the old church.
一道拱形的門通往那座古老的教堂。
The cat stood with its back arched when it saw the dog.
貓看到狗時弓起背站著。
The bridge has three arched openings over the river.
這座橋在河上有三個拱形的橋洞。
She held up the trophy triumphantly.
她得意洋洋地舉起獎盃。
The team returned triumphantly after winning the final.
球隊贏得決賽後凱旋歸來。
He triumphantly announced that he had solved the puzzle.
他得意地宣布自己解開了謎題。

murdered.zh: 謀殺（murder 的過去式／過去分詞）
ai: The detective found out who had murdered the old man.
偵探查出了是誰謀殺了那位老先生。
The writer was murdered in his own home, according to the report.
根據報導，那位作家在自己家中遇害。
Our team got murdered by the champions last night.
我們隊昨晚被冠軍隊打得慘敗。
We murdered them in the second half and won 5-0.
我們在下半場把他們痛宰，以五比零獲勝。
The company ran a sham charity to collect money.
那家公司開設了一個假慈善機構來斂財。
It was a sham marriage made only for the papers.
那是一場只為了拿證件而辦的假婚姻。
The election was a sham because the result was decided in advance.
那場選舉是個騙局，因為結果早就決定好了。
He realized the whole offer was a sham.
他發現整個優惠都是騙人的。
He shammed illness to stay home from school.
他假裝生病不去上學。
She shammed sleep so that she wouldn't have to talk.
她假裝睡著，這樣就不用說話。
France has a highly centralised government.
法國有高度中央集權的政府。
The company moved to a centralised system for storing data.
公司改用集中式系統來儲存資料。
The bank centralised its customer service in one office.
銀行把客服集中到一個辦公室。
They centralised all the records to make them easier to find.
他們把所有紀錄集中起來，讓它們更容易查找。
